title: The rehearsal where Seymour first discovers a woman pianist
summary: At the first rehearsal Seymour tried to have the girl removed from the piano until she played; then they accepted her. Seymour died within a year and the group was stranded in New York.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Seymour and Jeanette. A strange thing happened. We came to New York - I think it was New York we had gone, either New York or Rochester, some place. So we were getting ready to rehearse. I'd always stand at the piano and look at it before I tackled it. I was just sitting there. So Seymour came out and they introduced - I don't think they introduced him to everybody. He just came out, because he was sitting there and was irritable all the time. He said, "What's that girl doing, sitting at the piano?" Nobody would say anything. He said, "Well, get her off the stage so we can play." Nobody would say anything. So I didn't move so he said, "Let's start the rehearsal." So I started playing and both of them had a fit. They didn't know that John had a woman with them. They had a fit because during this period because a woman was not really allowed to be in with a group of men or anything. They were so surprised. So he said, "We can't take her. We can't let not Keith but the manager see her because she's a black woman and we've got to put pants on her." They were wondering what they were going to do. They said, "She's good, she's good!" So John said, "Forget it; listen to her play." So we went on with that and everything was fine. About 6 months or a year later Seymour died and John Williams and the combo and I worked with Jeanette for a while till we were stranded in New York.
